segments.contextBefore: Check whether your Metal app correctly reads and writes to memory by measuring the GPU’s memory bandwidth.

segments.contextAfter: The GPU bandwidth counters measure how much, in gigabytes per second, the GPU reads and writes, or *accesses* memory.
